title: mapspack v1 package.json
description: The `package.json` of a mapspack: which file in it belongs to which layer of its `map.mapson`, one map or several. A .mapszip or .mapsaar carries a mapspack; README.md describes both.

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this schema's $id.

version.description: Readers refuse a version newer than theirs.

items.description: One per layer that brings data, map by map, drawn first first. Layers without data are left out.

layerID.description: The layer's `id` in map.mapson, in whichever of its maps holds it.

cacheKey.description: The layer's tile store. Layers that share one, in one map or across maps, name the same `tiles`.

tiles.description: The layer's tiles, a .pmtiles at the mapspack's root. Absent when it has none.

files.description: Files the layer reads (GPX, GeoJSON, MBTiles…), under `files/`. May be empty.
